scripts.compose:dev:up: bun run --filter @minakata/web build && podman compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env up
scripts.compose:dev:up:agent: bun run --filter @minakata/web build && podman compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env --profile agent up
scripts.compose:dev:sync: bun run --filter @minakata/web build && podman compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env restart minakata
